name: app-blue-sky-floating-health-phone-above-hand
title: Floating Health App Above an Open Hand
whatItIs: A pale sky-blue cover with a phone tilted in mid-air above an open hand, showing a health dashboard with pastel cards, and giant ghost 'GlucCare' lettering behind, with a tagline and year.
whatItMeans: Levitating the phone above a hand suggests care and support, and the pastel blue field feels clean and clinical yet soft.
techniques: Device floating above a reaching hand
Ghost brand name split by the phone
Pastel card colours (blue, lilac, green, peach) for metrics
Radial pale blue glow behind the subject
Small tagline and date in the corners
bestFor: Product hero images with a human gesture

vocabulary.definition: Showing an object floating in space.
A softly coloured card showing one health stat.
Small text placed at the corners of a cover.
